content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a sovereign commerce stack — a complete combination of free and paid tools that give digital creators full control over their online stores. It replaces Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal with infrastructure the creator owns. The core is Cloudflare Workers, a serverless runtime that processes crypto payments via NOWPayments webhooks. Transactions settle directly to the creator’s wallet. No middlemen. No payout delays. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana averages fractions of a cent. The creator keeps 99.5% of every sale. This is not a workaround. It is base-layer infrastructure. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access. The creator owns the code, the data, and the payment flow.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with Cloudflare Pages hosting the storefront — free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers, triggered by customer actions. Payments process through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. The moment payment confirms on-chain, a webhook fires, updating order status in Supabase. Product delivery links generate via signed URLs from Cloudflare R2. Email receipts send through configured SPF/DKIM/DMARC records. Every component is modular. Swap Supabase for Google Sheets. Replace R2 with Google Drive. The architecture adapts to the creator’s needs. No single point of failure. No platform lock-in.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. Ebook authors in Ghana. Course creators in Bangladesh. Font designers in Venezuela. These creators sell globally but cannot collect payment through Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. The solution is infrastructure sovereignty — owning the tools that power your business. It is built for those who value lifetime access over monthly subscriptions. For those who prioritize direct customer relationships over platform algorithms. For those who refuse to be locked out of their own earnings.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction — ideal for digital product sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages hosts the storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, from payment processing to email delivery. Supabase stores order data, scalable and queryable. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing webhooks the moment transactions confirm. Cloudflare R2 delivers products securely via signed URLs. Each component is selected for its cost, reliability, and sovereignty. Cloudflare’s global network ensures low latency. Supabase’s Postgres backend ensures data ownership. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee ensures profitability. Together, these components form a stack that is both lightweight and enterprise-grade.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) — Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours. Includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested before handoff. 30-day support. Alternatively, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. Deploy manually or hire a developer. The stack is designed for clarity. Every line of code is documented. Every decision is explained. This is infrastructure as a product — not a service. You own it. You control it. You profit from it.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT payments on Tron arrive in minutes, costing under $0.10 per transaction. Solana payments confirm in seconds, with fees averaging fractions of a cent. Both networks are ideal for digital product sales due to their speed and low cost. Compare this to PayPal, which can take 3-5 business days to settle and charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya convert crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. The process is direct, fast, and avoids traditional banking delays.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for done-for-you deployment or The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for DIY. 2. Register a Cloudflare account to access Pages, Workers, and R2. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. 4. Configure Supabase for order storage or use Google Sheets as a free alternative. 5. Deploy your storefront via Cloudflare Pages. 6. Integrate NOWPayments webhooks into Cloudflare Workers for automatic payment verification. 7. Test end-to-end: purchase a product, verify payment, and confirm delivery. 8. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed for you in 48 hours. Includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested before handoff. 30-day support.
How do I convert crypto to local currency in Nigeria?

Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. These platforms connect you directly with buyers and sellers. Rates are market-driven, and transactions are fast. Avoid traditional banks for better exchange rates and faster settlements.
What if I want to sell more than five products?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes five products loaded. Additional products can be added manually or by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all blueprints and templates for unlimited products.
How secure is this architecture?

The stack uses Cloudflare’s global network for DDoS protection. Payments process via NOWPayments, which has no KYC requirements. Product delivery uses signed URLs from Cloudflare R2. Email receipts are secured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Data stored in Supabase is encrypted at rest.
What happens if Cloudflare or Supabase goes down?
Cloudflare has a 99.99% uptime SLA. Supabase runs on Postgres, which can be self-hosted if needed. The architecture is modular — swap components as necessary. No single point of failure.
